# Requirements

The 25-session (one-month) launch pass that folds the 2026-07-05 Neo/Cody/Cassandra audit into a sequenced, dependency-waved plan and fixes it to a commercial bar. Cody, spec/cody-client, and spec/cody-smoothness are specced and largely built, yet a real creative-build run was 'absolutely dog shit': the worker burned ~90 model calls flailing for a screenshot it could never take (Y3 — the screenshot gate is unsatisfiable without an external browser service), turned in with absolute paths a blind adjudicator could not read (Y1 — gate.renderSource skips absolute paths, so Cassandra sees no file source), was rejected three times with no possible action (Y6 — no unsatisfiable-gate detection), and the plan died producing nothing viewable. Neo separately still spiralled on a completion loop (N2 — the task_complete branch bypasses the stall detector and genuine work resets the nudge counter, so an interleaved work->premature-complete->reject pattern is bounded only by the step budget). The two most safety-critical test suites do not even compile (N1/C1 — a citation-removal refactor left neo/internal/agent and cassandra tests calling deleted symbols), so there is zero regression protection on the completion gate and the completeness auditor. This feature removes the shared failure class (one path-normalization seam; capability-aware satisfiable gates; unified unproductive-attempt accounting; one shared acceptance predicate that fails toward refusal), restores regression safety, brings Cody's depth up (cached-recon economy, ceremony fast-path, the intended spec.kvx/design.body.md/specgen pipeline with research + clarifying-questions phases), polishes the built /cody coding surface to the Claude Code bar (design-quality conformance + house rules, progress/narration, diff/tree fidelity, live terminal + dev-server preview, plan board + real evidence cards), and PROVES it with no-fakes end-to-end tests including a creative build that produces a real running preview and a real screenshot. The bar is non-negotiable: as good as Claude Code, for users, no exceptions; every session is production/commercial grade (Google/AWS/Microsoft), no shortcuts, no fakes. Each task is ONE session worked under the baked-in protocol (recall + previous-session handoff -> straight to the one eligible task -> build on real code -> write and run tests, fixing ALL broken tests even pre-existing ones -> green -> mark done, write the next-session handoff, record a cortex outcome, close out).

## Requirement 1: Regression safety restored — the safety-critical test suites compile and cover the failure shapes

**User Story:** As the owner, I want the completion gate and the completeness auditor under real, compiling, passing tests, so that no future refactor can silently break the subsystems that spiralled.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE neo/internal/agent test package SHALL compile and pass: stale calls to removed symbols (3-arg verdictAccepts, 6-arg buildAuditContract, salientTokens) SHALL be updated to the current API against REAL cassandra.Verdict values, never fakes.
2. THE cassandra test package SHALL compile and pass: tests referencing the removed CheckCitations SHALL be re-expressed against the current transcript-judged behavior.
3. go build ./... , go vet ./... , and go test ./... SHALL be green in both the neo and cassandra modules.
4. A CI-style check SHALL forbid a non-compiling or red module test package (the process gap that let the refactor land untested).

## Requirement 2: Unified workspace-path normalization seam in Cody

**User Story:** As the engine, I want one place that turns any model-supplied path into a clean workspace-relative path, so that navigation, mutation records, and adjudication all agree on path shape.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. CODY SHALL define ONE normalization function that resolves a model-supplied path against the workspace root, rejects escapes, and yields a clean workspace-relative path.
2. worker.toolList / toolRead / toolWrite / toolDelete SHALL normalize the incoming path through the seam — an absolute in-root path SHALL behave identically to its relative form (the filepath.Join double-join SHALL be eliminated).
3. worker.recordChange SHALL store the normalized workspace-relative path so report.Changes never carries an absolute path.
4. A test SHALL prove an absolute in-root path and its relative form produce identical fs_list/fs_write/record behavior.

## Requirement 3: Adjudication evidence completeness — the gate always sees the real changed source

**User Story:** As the user, I want the adjudicator to judge the code that was actually written, so that a correct UI/structural change is never rejected as 'unconfirmed'.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. gate.renderSource SHALL relativize a report.Changes path against the workspace root before reading it, so an absolute in-root path is included in the adjudication evidence (never skipped).
2. THE do-not-touch and test-weakening screens SHALL compare normalized paths so an absolute-path change is screened identically to its relative form.
3. THE planner SHALL emit workspace-relative paths in a sheet's goal, verification commands, and grounding, so the worker is primed with the relative shape.
4. A test SHALL reproduce the logged shape: a worker writes an absolute-path file; the gate's evidence contains that file's source; the real adjudicator grounds on it.

## Requirement 4: UI verification degrades gracefully — the screenshot gate is never unsatisfiable

**User Story:** As a user, I want UI tasks to succeed even where a browser service is not wired, so that a correct deliverable is never rejected for infrastructure it cannot control.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE worker SHALL probe screenshot capability (browser service reachable) and expose it as a typed signal, not a message-in-the-path-slot.
2. WHEN screenshot capability is present, THE screenshot gate SHALL bind as today (a UI turn-in that changed a rendered surface must carry a real screenshot artifact).
3. WHEN screenshot capability is ABSENT, THE gate SHALL degrade to a non-blocking advisory plus a deterministic render check — never an unsatisfiable hard rejection.
4. browserScreenshot SHALL signal 'not configured' via a typed result, and no caller SHALL record that message as a screenshot path.

## Requirement 5: Structurally-unsatisfiable-gate detection — stop-and-ask or replan, never burn attempts

**User Story:** As the user, I want Cody to recognize when a gate cannot be satisfied by any worker action, so that it asks me or replans instead of failing the plan on three identical rejections.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE orchestrator SHALL detect when the same gate rejection reason repeats across attempts with no worker action able to resolve it (an unsatisfiable gate).
2. ON an unsatisfiable gate, THE orchestrator SHALL stop-and-ask the user or replan the task, rather than re-authoring the same sheet until the attempt ceiling.
3. A test SHALL prove an unsatisfiable gate stops-and-asks (or replans) rather than consuming all MaxAttempts with identical rejections.

## Requirement 6: One shared acceptance predicate across Neo, Cody, and Cassandra

**User Story:** As the owner, I want a single definition of 'the verdict accepts completion', so that the three consumers can never drift apart.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. cassandra.Sound() SHALL be the single source of truth for verdict acceptance (grounded AND no unverified claims AND coverage complete).
2. neo.verdictAccepts and Cody's gate.Adjudicate SHALL call cassandra.Sound() (or a shared exported predicate) rather than re-implementing the rule inline.
3. A test SHALL prove the same Verdict yields the same accept/reject decision in Neo, Cody, and Cassandra.

## Requirement 7: Cassandra fails toward refusal on degenerate/low-confidence verdicts

**User Story:** As the owner, I want the auditor to default to caution, so that a malformed or unsure verdict is never read as success.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A parsed verdict missing coverage/groundedness signals SHALL normalize toward refusal (NOT default to coverage=full / grounded=true).
2. TIERED escalation SHALL keep the STRICTER (or more certain) verdict, never unconditionally replace a stricter primary verdict with a less-certain escalated one.
3. THE goal-type classification (question / status / truthful-no) SHALL be covered by a test with a grounding guard, so an UNCHECKED negative cannot pass as complete.

## Requirement 8: Neo completion loop bounded by unified unproductive-attempt accounting

**User Story:** As a user, I want Neo to stop and hand off honestly when it cannot close, so that it never spends the whole step budget on a work->premature-complete->reject loop.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. NEO SHALL track unproductive attempts on ONE counter that completion-gate rejections, no-progress stalls, and guidance nudges all feed.
2. ONLY genuine accepted progress SHALL reset that counter — a genuine tool call interleaved between completion rejections SHALL NOT silently reset the completion-reject bound.
3. THE completion branch SHALL advance the no-progress/stall read before it continues (it SHALL NOT bypass stall detection).
4. A test SHALL drive an interleaved work->premature-complete->reject pattern and prove it terminates with an honest partial within the unified bound, well before the step budget.

## Requirement 9: Worker context economy — the cached workspace map rides the sheet

**User Story:** As the engine, I want the worker to start already oriented, so that it does not spend several steps re-scanning a workspace the orchestrator already modeled.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE sheet grounding SHALL carry a cached workspace map (tree/languages/entry points) from the orchestrator's workspace model.
2. THE worker SHALL use the cached map for initial orientation and SHALL NOT re-scan the whole workspace before starting the task.
3. A test SHALL prove a worker on a seeded repo performs no redundant full-workspace scan when the cached map is present.

## Requirement 10: Ceremony scales to intent — a fast path for low-stakes asks

**User Story:** As a vibe coder, I want a quick prototype to start coding almost immediately, so that Cody is as responsive as Claude Code without abandoning the constitution.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A low-stakes / Prototype intent SHALL take a fast path that collapses the SDR + multi-candidate DLR + multi-candidate planner ceremony into a lean start.
2. THE constitution SHALL bind identically on the fast path (no fakes, verify-before-done, honest partials, complete artifacts).
3. A test SHALL prove the fast path issues materially fewer pre-code LLM calls than the full ceremony while both hold the constitution.

## Requirement 11: The intended spec pipeline — spec.kvx + design.body.md via specgen, with research and clarifying questions

**User Story:** As an Architect-mode user, I want Cody to author real durable spec artifacts and to understand the ask first, so that long-horizon work is planned to the same bar this repo uses.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. ARCHITECT mode SHALL author a real spec.kvx plus design.body.md for the project and invoke specgen to render requirements.md / design.md / tasks.md — replacing the hand-rolled .cody/spec markdown.
2. PLANNING SHALL be preceded by a research phase that gathers grounding (workspace + relevant sources) before the plan is authored.
3. WHEN the ask is underspecified, CODY SHALL ask clarifying questions through the answer channel BEFORE planning, not guess.
4. A test SHALL prove the authored spec.kvx round-trips through the real specgen parser and that the research / clarifying-questions phases gate planning.

## Requirement 12: Coding workspace UI at the Claude Code bar

**User Story:** As a user, I want the coding surface to feel as good as Claude Code, so that directing Cody and seeing my running app is smooth, legible, and never a dead-silent blank.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE built /cody surface (spec/cody-client, spec/cody-smoothness) SHALL be audited and brought into conformance with rules/web/design-quality.md and the house rules: separation by background-color contrast only (never border strokes for depth), no emojis, no purple/indigo gradients, no glow.
2. THE progress spine SHALL never be blank while running or awaiting (including the approve->next-phase gap), and Cody SHALL narrate as it works.
3. THE diff review, file tree, live terminal, and dev-server preview SHALL show real, navigable, faithful state — the user SEES the running result of a build.
4. THE plan board and turn-in cards SHALL carry real verification evidence in RESULT language, with zero orchestrator/worker/sheet jargon in consumer copy; the explanation register SHALL follow the active mode.

## Requirement 13: No-fakes proof — the creative build runs green end to end, and every module is green under coverage

**User Story:** As the owner, I want the exact failure shapes reproduced as passing tests and the whole stack green, so that launch-readiness is proven, not asserted.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A creative-build E2E SHALL run a seeded 'make me a small web app' task to a real running dev-server preview and a real screenshot artifact, gate-accepted, with NO stub/mock/fake anywhere in the path.
2. THE Y1/Y2/Y9 absolute-path shape, the Y3 unsatisfiable-screenshot shape, the N2 Neo loop shape, and the C2/C3 degenerate-verdict shape SHALL each be covered by a real regression test.
3. go build/vet/test ./... (with -race where concurrency is touched) SHALL be green across cody, neo, and cassandra; the client coding-workspace reducer tests SHALL be green.
4. A coverage gate SHALL hold on the changed packages; NO test in this feature SHALL substitute a stub/mock/fake for a real code path or type to manufacture a pass.

## Requirement 14: The 25-session working protocol and quality bar as a durable operating contract

**User Story:** As the owner, I want the per-session protocol and the commercial quality bar written into this feature's source of truth, so that every session is worked the same disciplined way.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE spec SHALL carry the per-session protocol (recall + read-full + previous-session handoff -> one eligible task in_progress -> build on real code -> write and run tests fixing ALL broken tests even pre-existing -> green -> mark done + write handoff + cortex outcome + close out; guard before risk) as a durable, queryable contract.
2. THE spec SHALL carry the non-negotiable quality bar (commercial/production grade; no fakes; bounded loops and satisfiable gates; constitution in every mode; UI house rules; the Claude Code bar).
3. EVERY task in this feature SHALL be worked under that protocol, and the final checkpoint SHALL attest that it was.
